Power Outages Announced in Jodhpur and Keshkal

Electricity will be cut for four hours in Jodhpur on a specified day, affecting certain areas. In Keshkal, the electricity department has scheduled maintenance from October 14 to October 19, during which power will be suspended for eight hours daily in designated regions. Schedules for these outages have been released.
